rootCause: The production server ran inside the restricted network sandbox. Every JD adapter fetch failed before any provider response was received.

matrixDisposition.reason: Phase 2.5 policy stores infrastructure failures separately; a request with no provider response and no generated content is not a content sample.

runnerFinding.finding: The runner continued scheduling after a systemic infrastructure failure and its summary labeled all scheduled entries as failed content cases.
runnerFinding.requiredCorrection: Classify provider/transport infrastructure failures separately and stop the batch immediately after the first such failure.
